correctness_stopping_rule: A runtime implementation is correct for this milestone when it executes the official checkpoint with required model/operator semantics, precision and storage contracts, layer behavior, persistent-state lifecycle, generation-state semantics, backend-local deterministic behavior for the qualified deterministic configuration, and correct discrete algorithms on values produced by that valid backend trajectory.
required_fidelity_properties: official checkpoint identity and tensor authority
precision and storage contracts including physical compressed/index payloads where required
backend-local deterministic execution for fixed checkpoint/runtime/build/config/input/session state
correct discrete algorithms on backend-produced values
explicit_non_requirements: canonical CUDA/NumPy/Metal reduction ordering to force token identity
deferred_qualification_areas: production implementation qualification under backend-local policy
next_frontier: validate/finish the practical production MLX/oMLX-derived decode path against the finalized backend-local correctness policy
